verdicts.reason: A keeps the original left-to-right order, but the logo is blown up to fill almost the whole height. It nearly touches the top and bottom edges and outweighs the headline and the CTA, so the hierarchy is wrong. B has a clean left-aligned stack of headline, subcopy and CTA with the logo at a sensible size on the right. Its flaws: the logo moves from first to last in the reading order, the middle is a large dead gap, and the CTA sits closer to the bottom edge than the headline does to the top.
